fields.placeLabel: Facility name, or "<county> County" for county rules.
fields.projectName: Optional. The organisation that recorded the cases.
fields.caseCount: Number of cases in the event.
fields.windowLabel: The rule's window in words: "1 day", "3 days".
fields.firstCaseDate: Date of the first case, e.g. 17 Nov 2026.
fields.cases: List of {caseNumber, date, status, sex, age, area, facility}. De-identified: no names, IDs or contact details.
fields.reportUrl: Optional. Link to the event report in Afiax.
fields.countyScope: true for county-wide rules: adds a Facility column and points questions to the facilities.
